unit.title: Verb Tenses and a Day in Your Life

contentBlocks.text: ਕੱਲ੍ਹ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਭੂਤਕਾਲ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ। ਅੱਜ: ਭਵਿੱਖਤ ਕਾਲ! (Yesterday you learned past tense. Today: future tense!)

Future tense shows something that hasn't happened yet: ਜਾਵਾਂਗਾ/ਜਾਵਾਂਗੀ means 'will go,' changing with gender just like every other tense you've learned. Compare all three tenses for the same verb: ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹਾਂ (I go, present), ਗਿਆ (I went, past), ਜਾਵਾਂਗਾ (I will go, future). Practice: say 'ਮੈਂ ਸਕੂਲ ਜਾਵਾਂਗਾ' or 'ਜਾਵਾਂਗੀ' about tomorrow.
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਭਵਿੱਖਤ ਕਾਲ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ! (You just learned future tense!) Tomorrow we'll learn daily-life vocabulary to use with all three tenses.

objectives: Compare present, past, and future tense forms of the same verb
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review yesterday's past-tense work.
2. Introduce future tense, comparing all three tenses of ਜਾਣਾ side by side.
3. Have the child say a future-tense sentence about tomorrow.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's daily-life-vocabulary lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: write all three tense forms of ਜਾਣਾ side by side on one line as a visual reference
Ready for more: ask the child to say the same sentence in all three tenses (past, present, future) about going somewhere
This lesson completes a genuine three-tense system — present (already known), past (yesterday), future (today)
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a vocabulary-acquisition and comparison activity — check that the child correctly traces/writes ਜਾਵਾਂਗਾ/ਜਾਵਾਂਗੀ and can correctly say all three tense forms of ਜਾਣਾ.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'grammar mastery' goal, completing the present/past/future tense system for the first time this course.

rows.problem: Write ਜਾਣਾ's present, past, and future tense forms (masculine).
Which tense would you use to talk about tomorrow?
